properties.name: uac_binop_ctype
properties.formal: forall t1,t2 in CScalarTypes^2, op in BinOps. expr_types[(t1 a; t2 b; int p = a op b;).init] == C11_uac(promote(t1), promote(t2), op)
properties.counterexample: t1="unsigned long", t2="long long", op="+" — expr_types[a+b] == LongLong, C11 6.3.1.8 requires ULongLong (gcc-verified)

properties.name: enum_constant_type_bands
properties.formal: forall v in i64 (boundary-exact). enum_constant_type(v) == Int if v in [i32::MIN,i32::MAX]; UInt if in [2^31,2^32-1]; ULongLong if > 2^32-1; LongLong if < i32::MIN

properties.name: enum_variant_values_model
properties.formal: forall variants in VariantList. analyze("enum { A0[=e0], ... }") implies forall i. enum_constants[Ai] == ei if explicit else prev+1 — no panic on any legal token stream
properties.counterexample: variants = [("A", Some(9223372036854775807))] — `enum { A = 9223372036854775807LL };` panics "attempt to add with overflow" at parser/types.rs:828 (gcc: "overflow in enumeration values" diagnostic instead)

properties.name: typecontext_scope_undo_state_machine
properties.formal: Automaton: states = layered scope maps (typedefs, enum_constants, typedef_alignments, ctype_cache, struct_layouts); ops = Push|Pop|Insert*; invariant: after each op every map equals the layered model (Pop on empty stack = no-op)
properties.counterexample: ops = [Push, Al(1,0), Al(1,0), Pop] — typedef_alignments["kB"] survives the pop (same-scope re-insert resurrection)

properties.name: scope_shadow_via_analyze
properties.formal: forall (g,l). analyze("enum { E = g; }; void f(void){ enum { E = l; } } enum { F = E + 0 };") implies enum_constants[F] == g
properties.counterexample: g=1, l=2 — `enum { E = 1 }; void f(void) { enum { E = 2 }; } enum { F = E + 0 };` gives F == 2 (inner value leaked past scope exit)

properties.name: return_type_fallthrough_model
properties.formal: forall body in generated function bodies. warning_emitted("int f(void){body}") == model_falls_through(body) per the documented -Wreturn-type rules

properties.name: const_arith_c_semantics
properties.formal: forall e in integer Expr (C11-defined subset; UB excluded per 6.5p5/6.5.5p6/6.5.6p3/6.5.7p3-4). const_values[(int p = e;).init] == model_c_eval(e)
properties.counterexample: e = Un("-", Bin("+", Cast("unsigned", Lit(0)), Lit(-1))) — `int p = -((unsigned)(0) + (-1));` const-folds to -4294967295; C (gcc 9.4) wraps to 1

properties.name: sizeof_alignof_abi_table
properties.formal: forall T in TypeGrid. const_value(sizeof(T)) == abi_size(T) and const_value(_Alignof(T)) == abi_align(T) per x86-64 SysV

properties.name: ternary_elvis_const_semantics
properties.formal: forall (c,a,b) in ConstInts^3. const_value(c ? a : b) == (c!=0 ? a : b) and const_value(c ?: b) == (c!=0 ? c : b)

properties.name: builtin_family_recognition
properties.formal: forall name in Generated{prefix, op, suffix}. is_builtin(name) == (op in documented_family(prefix) and suffix in {eps,1,2,4,8,16})

properties.name: libc_alias_and_sync_strip
properties.formal: forall op,s. strip("__sync_"+op+"_"+s) == "__sync_"+op and strip(strip(x)) == strip(x); forall n in LibcFamily. resolve_builtin("__builtin_"+n) == LibcAlias(n)

properties.name: functions_map_contract
properties.formal: forall (ret,params,variadic,noreturn,defined). FunctionInfo[f] == {ret, params, variadic, is_defined: defined, is_noreturn: noreturn-sticky}

properties.name: implicit_function_declaration_contract
properties.formal: forall name not in Builtins. functions[name] == {Int, variadic, !defined} and warning emitted; forall name in Builtins. no implicit-declaration entry/warning

properties.name: parse_src_failure_path
properties.formal: forall src in MutatedPrograms (guaranteed-malformed arms). parse_src(src) returns a TU with errs >= 1 and never panics (parser README §13 recovery contract)

properties.name: sut_tokens_markers_stripped
properties.formal: forall src in SimplePrograms union MalformedPrograms. t = sut_tokens(pp, src) implies no panic and no '#<digit>' line-marker token in t; src well-formed additionally implies tokens(join(" ", t)) == t

bugs.summary: usual_arithmetic_conversion: unsigned long + long long typed as signed LongLong (C11 6.3.1.8 rule 5 broken)
bugs.impact: Mixed size_t/unsigned-long vs long-long expressions get signed semantics: wrapped unsigned values compare >= 0, divide and shift differently than gcc; the same shared conversion is used downstream of sema.
bugs.expected: ULongLong (unsigned counterpart when the higher-ranked signed type is same-width)
bugs.counterexample: t1="unsigned long", t2="long long", op="+" — expr_types[a+b] == LongLong, C11 6.3.1.8 requires ULongLong (gcc-verified)
bugs.fix: In src/common/types.rs usual_arithmetic_conversion final else: only return the signed type when its SIZE exceeds the unsigned operand's size; otherwise return the unsigned counterpart of the signed type's rank.

bugs.summary: Function-local enum constant permanently clobbers the global one (undo-log has no enums_shadowed restore)
bugs.impact: Silent wrong compile-time constants: after any function with a local `enum { E = ... }`, the global E keeps the inner value for the rest of the TU.
bugs.expected: enum_constants["F"] == 1 (global E restored after f's scope pops)
bugs.counterexample: g=1, l=2 — `enum { E = 1 }; void f(void) { enum { E = 2 }; } enum { F = E + 0 };` gives F == 2 (inner value leaked past scope exit)
bugs.fix: Add enums_shadowed: Vec<(String, i64)> to TypeScopeFrame; in insert_enum_scoped record the previous value when the key exists and was not already touched this frame; restore in pop_scope.
bugs.documentedBehavior: "Pop the top type-system scope frame and undo changes to enum_constants, struct_layouts, ctype_cache, and typedefs." — src/frontend/sema/type_context.rs:376-378

bugs.summary: enum with explicit i64::MAX value panics with integer overflow (parser types.rs:828 and sema enum_counter)
bugs.impact: Debug builds panic (crash on a legal token stream); release builds silently wrap the enum counter to i64::MIN. gcc 9.4 instead diagnoses 'overflow in enumeration values'.
bugs.expected: A diagnostic (like gcc), never a panic
bugs.actual: panic "attempt to add with overflow" at parser/types.rs:828 (val + 1); sema analysis.rs:717 enum_counter += 1 has the same defect
bugs.counterexample: variants = [("A", Some(9223372036854775807))] — `enum { A = 9223372036854775807LL };` panics "attempt to add with overflow" at parser/types.rs:828 (gcc: "overflow in enumeration values" diagnostic instead)
bugs.fix: Use checked_add / saturating semantics on both enum counters (parser next_value and sema enum_counter) and emit an 'overflow in enumeration values' diagnostic like gcc.

bugs.summary: TypeContext undo-log resurrects a same-scope re-inserted value after pop (typedefs/alignments/layouts/ctype_cache)
bugs.impact: Same-scope redeclarations (accepted by design) leak their value past the scope: `void f(void){ typedef int T; typedef long T; }` leaves T = long after f.
bugs.expected: kB absent after pop (it did not exist before push)
bugs.counterexample: ops = [Push, Al(1,0), Al(1,0), Pop] — typedef_alignments["kB"] survives the pop (same-scope re-insert resurrection)
bugs.fix: In the insert_*_scoped family, record added/shadowed only when the key was not already touched in the current frame (e.g. check frame lists before recording); pop then restores correctly.

bugs.summary: SemaConstEval unary minus on unsigned constants does not wrap modulo 2^width
bugs.impact: Enum values, array sizes, and static initializers built from negated unsigned constant expressions get a negative value instead of the wrapped unsigned one (e.g. -4294967295 instead of 1).
bugs.expected: const_values[p] == 1 (-(4294967295u) wraps to 1u; C11 6.5.3.3p4, gcc 9.4 agrees)
bugs.counterexample: e = Un("-", Bin("+", Cast("unsigned", Lit(0)), Lit(-1))) — `int p = -((unsigned)(0) + (-1));` const-folds to -4294967295; C (gcc 9.4) wraps to 1
bugs.fix: Mirror the sibling BitNot fix-up in the UnaryOp::Neg arm of SemaConstEval::eval_const_expr: after negate_const, re-wrap unsigned operands to their width (u32/u64 mask) before storing.
